pr_body:
Previously, we were passing an RLocked Replica to addToReplicasByKeyLocked.
That method internally visits the descriptors in replicasByKey, which calls
Desc() that may cause a recursive call to RLock if the added replica intersects
itself. This is only possible in tests which try to reinsert the Replica to the
map; in prod code each Replica is inserted to replicasByKey only once.

This PR avoids the possibility of this deadlock by shifting the responsibility
of locking to the caller.

Fixes #96931

Release note: none
Epic: none
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/97381)

@tbg Could you take another look? The previous version of this PR was deadlock-full. I fixed the deadlock at the cost of some duplication: the caller now passes the replica's `Desc()` or `descRLocked()` depending on the locking state.

@pavelkalinnikov this looks like a problem in 

https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/736a67e0d36cc545bf74d65db069ee895ff9bea0/pkg/kv/kvserver/store_create_replica.go#L255-L276

In that method, we hold `Replica.mu`. But then we call `.Desc()` here which gets a recursive `RLock`:

https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/f01c861457d9e5bae8cc08b0d5f66e0fbf62e37d/pkg/kv/kvserver/store_replica_btree.go#L131

There are other calls to `Desc()` from the `replicasByKey` btree so this is a more general issue. Possibly this was tickled with recent refactors we made in that area and previously flew under the radar.
(The reason recursive RLock() is bad is because if someone else is trying to `Lock()` while we have the first `RLock()` but not the second, we'll be deadlocked)
Marking as GA blocker to make sure we investigate before release. Deadlocks = bad grey failures, so this occurring in the wild could have a large blast radius.

`it.Desc` is called for the result of `getOverlappingKeyRangeLocked`, which shouldn't return our replica. Maybe it does sometimes. Note that this is a "return error" flow which is supposed to not happen.
Ah, there are more `Desc` calls inside `getOverlappingKeyRangeLocked`, I see.

review_comments:
> `repl.mu` must be unlocked

You can sort of "assert" that it is by adding `repl.mu.Lock(); repl.mu.Unlock()` at the top of this method.
Or maybe we can push this into `addToReplicasByKeyLocked`, which has multiple callers. Do none of them hold a lock on the repl?
There is one caller who holds a lock (`applySnapshot`). This caused a deadlock in this PR.

This is a pre-existing (before refactoring) risk, see how it was a few months ago: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/48ef0d89e6179c0d348a5236ad308d81fa392f7c/pkg/kv/kvserver/store_create_replica.go#L374-L386.
